title: PUMA Half Marathon Series CDO 2026 Review: Mindanao Big-Cat Race
seo_title: PUMA Half Marathon CDO 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 CDO. RUNRIO-produced, PUMA-branded race in Cagayan de Oro.
dek: The CDO leg of the RUNRIO-produced, PUMA-branded Philippine Half Marathon Series. Registration pending.
verdict: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series CDO brings the RUNRIO-PUMA collaboration to Cagayan de Oro — Mindanao's 'City of Golden Friendship.' RUNRIO's gold-standard production + PUMA's global sportswear branding = a premium race experience with quality merchandise. CDO's adventure-tourism infrastructure makes it a compelling race destination. Registration isn't open yet. For runners wanting a brand-backed, professionally-produced CDO half marathon, this is worth tracking.

sections.heading: PUMA + RUNRIO in CDO
paragraphs: The RUNRIO-PUMA combination brings premium production and sportswear branding to Cagayan de Oro. [1] CDO is Mindanao's adventure capital — white-water rafting and highland access make it a compelling race destination.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A PUMA-RUNRIO branded race in CDO. Track for registration. [1]

faqs.question: When is PUMA Half Marathon CDO 2026?
faqs.answer: 6 September 2026 at Centrio Mall, Cagayan de Oro. It's the CDO leg of the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series, offering 21K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is pending; Runrio organises the event. [1]
